CHEMISTRY — TERMLY EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: CHEMISTRY
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Milk souring
   D. Ice melting to water

2. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Alkanols ● Introduction to alkanols ● Classification of alkanols ● Nomenclature ? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Alkanols ● Introduction to alkanols ● Classification of alkanols ● Nomenclature .
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Alkanols ● Introduction to alkanols ● Classification of alkanols ● Nomenclature .
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Alkanols ● Introduction to alkanols ● Classification of alkanols ● Nomenclature .
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Alkanols ● Introduction to alkanols ● Classification of alkanols ● Nomenclature .

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy Changes in physical and chemical processes 2.2. Electrochemistry 2.3 Nucl? (1 mark)

   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy Changes in physical and chemical processes 2.2. Electrochemistry 2.3 Nucl.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Energy Changes in physical and chemical processes 2.2. Electrochemistry 2.3 Nucl.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy Changes in physical and chemical processes 2.2. Electrochemistry 2.3 Nucl.

5. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Overgrazing continuously

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electrochemistry 2.3 Nuclear chemistry 3.0 Organic Chemistry 3.1 Alkanols 3.2 Al? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electrochemistry 2.3 Nuclear chemistry 3.0 Organic Chemistry 3.1 Alkanols 3.2 Al.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Electrochemistry 2.3 Nuclear chemistry 3.0 Organic Chemistry 3.1 Alkanols 3.2 Al.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrochemistry 2.3 Nuclear chemistry 3.0 Organic Chemistry 3.1 Alkanols 3.2 Al.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electrochemistry 2.3 Nuclear chemistry 3.0 Organic Chemistry 3.1 Alkanols 3.2 Al.

7. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 50 °C

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy Changes in physical and chemical processes ● System and surrounding ● Ene? (1 mark)

9. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

10. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Producers

11. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. watt (W)
   C. joule (J)
   D. pascal (Pa)
